judgement.explanation: The browser agent searched for 'canon camera' just as the customer did and reached the real search results page, which said no products matched. That is the problem the customer reported. The shop does sell Canon products such as the Canon EOS 5D, so the search seems to fail when you type more than one word, for example a brand plus 'camera'. (Note: made before the claim double-check existed. The judge relied on its own memory that the shop sells a Canon EOS 5D. Re-run below with Kane checking it.)
